articles.summary: Chiron Real Estate Inc. (NYSE: XRN) (the “Company” or “Chiron”) announced today that its Board of Directors has appointed Charles P. Fitzgerald as Chairman of the Board, effective immediately. Jeffrey Busch, the Company’s founder and outgoing Chairman, will remain a director following this transition. Mr. Fitzgerald has served as a director of Chiron since May 2026 and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Maewyn Capital Partners LLC (“Maewyn”), a Dallas-based investment firm focused on unlocking value across markets and cycles through both private real estate opportunities and select public real estate investments. In May 2026, Maewyn and its investment partners made a $100 million strategic investment in Chiron through a convertible perpetual preferred security designed to provide the Company with long-duration capital to support its growth and strategic transformation.
